sampling_method: Every own-result cell in frame_locations was assigned a contiguous 1-based index in reading order (location order below, row-major within a table, left-to-right within a paragraph), giving a population of 1..131. random.seed(20260810); random.sample(population, 15) drew {1, 2, 12, 13, 14, 25, 29, 70, 79, 83, 91, 99, 107, 108, 122}; each label below records its draw as frame_index. A number-with-delta pair printed together in one clause (e.g. the abstract's "86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement)") is counted once, as the absolute value; the delta is treated as elaboration on it, not a separate cell. Where a delta is the only number printed at a location (no paired absolute value there), the delta itself is counted as that location's cell (e.g. Section 4.1's "4.5% ... average accuracy improvement").
